where.if: AND (INSTR(t.name, #{keyword}) > 0 OR INSTR(COALESCE(t.description, ''), #{keyword}) > 0 OR CAST(t.id AS CHAR) = #{keyword})

mapper.select:
SELECT t.id, t.name, t.description, t.task_type, t.execution_frequency, t.owner, t.enabled, t.sql_content, t.parameter_schema, t.sql_checksum, t.revision, t.effective_version_no, t.archived, t.archived_by, t.archived_time, t.created_by, t.updated_by, t.create_time, t.update_time, e.status AS last_execution_status, e.submitted_at AS last_execution_at, (SELECT MAX(v.version_no) FROM sql_task_version v WHERE v.task_id = t.id) AS latest_version_no, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sql_task_version_step vs WHERE vs.task_id = t.id AND vs.version_no = t.effective_version_no) AS step_count FROM sql_task t LEFT JOIN sql_task_execution e ON e.id = (SELECT MAX(le.id) FROM sql_task_execution le WHERE le.task_id = t.id)
ORDER BY t.update_time DESC, t.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}

SELECT id, name, description, task_type, execution_frequency, owner, enabled, sql_content, ddl_content, parameter_schema, sql_checksum, revision, effective_version_no, archived, archived_by, archived_time, created_by, updated_by, create_time, update_time FROM sql_task WHERE id = #{taskId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE sql_task SET name = #{task.name}, description = #{task.description}, task_type = #{task.taskType}, execution_frequency = #{task.executionFrequency}, owner = #{task.owner}, updated_by = #{task.updatedBy}, revision = revision + 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{task.id} AND revision = #{expectedRevision} AND archived = 0
UPDATE sql_task SET enabled = #{enabled}, updated_by = #{operator}, revision = revision + 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{taskId} AND revision = #{expectedRevision} AND archived = 0

UPDATE sql_task SET archived = #{archived}, archived_by = CASE WHEN #{archived} THEN #{operator} ELSE NULL END, archived_time = CASE WHEN #{archived} THEN NOW() ELSE NULL END, updated_by = #{operator}, revision = revision + 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{taskId} AND revision = #{expectedRevision}

UPDATE sql_task SET name = #{task.name}, description = #{task.description}, sql_content = #{task.sqlContent}, ddl_content = #{task.ddlContent}, parameter_schema = #{task.parameterSchema}, sql_checksum = #{task.sqlChecksum}, effective_version_no = #{task.effectiveVersionNo}, updated_by = #{task.updatedBy}, revision = revision + 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{task.id} AND revision = #{expectedRevision} AND archived = 0
mapper.select: SELECT t.id,t.name,t.enabled,s.schedule_type,s.last_run_status,s.next_trigger_time, e.id AS last_execution_id,e.status AS last_execution_status,e.submitted_at AS last_execution_at, b.id AS last_backfill_id,b.status AS last_backfill_status FROM sql_task t LEFT JOIN sql_task_schedule s ON s.task_id=t.id LEFT JOIN sql_task_execution e ON e.id=(SELECT MAX(x.id) FROM sql_task_execution x WHERE x.task_id=t.id) LEFT JOIN sql_task_backfill_batch b ON b.id=(SELECT MAX(x.id) FROM sql_task_backfill_batch x WHERE x.task_id=t.id) WHERE t.archived=0 AND t.enabled=1 ORDER BY t.id

SELECT e.task_id, TIMESTAMPDIFF(MICROSECOND,COALESCE(e.started_at,e.submitted_at),e.finished_at) DIV 1000 AS duration_ms FROM sql_task_execution e WHERE e.status='SUCCEEDED' AND e.finished_at IS NOT NULL AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sql_task_execution newer WHERE newer.task_id=e.task_id AND newer.status='SUCCEEDED' AND newer.finished_at IS NOT NULL AND newer.id>e.id) < 20 ORDER BY e.task_id,e.id DESC
